Slop Drive guide

Getting started with Slop Drive

Slop Drive is the file store every Slopographic app shares. Files you save in one app are here, and you can open them in another. Everything stays in this browser.

Open Slop Drive

Add files and folders

Choose New, then Upload files… or New folder. You can also drop files and folders straight onto the window. New also makes an empty document for apps such as Slop Docs.

Find and open

Search Slop Drive at the top finds files in every folder. The buttons above the files switch between six views: grid, list, compact, columns, nodes and disk usage. All kinds narrows the list to one kind of file.

Double-click a file to open it in its app, or right-click it for Open with, Quick look, Rename…, Add tags…, Move to… and more. Recent, Starred and Trash are on the left.

Keep your files safe

The storage box shows how much space you use. Ask the browser to keep it asks the browser not to clear your files when space runs low. Backup & restore… saves everything in one file and brings it back. Connect folder… keeps a copy of your files in a folder on this computer, in Chrome and Edge.
